// Choose operation: "backup" or "setup". Scheduled runs always back up.
// Set one shared Notion parent page OR an existing data source; credentials stay in the API nodes.
const config={
  "operation": "backup",
  "notionParentPageId": "",
  "catalogTitle": "n8n Workflow Backups",
  "documentationDataSourceId": "",
  "documentationRootPageId": "",
  "n8nOrigin": "https://n8n.example.com",
  "n8nApiBase": "https://n8n.example.com/api/v1",
  "propertyNames": {},
  "includeInactive": true,
  "includeArchived": true,
  "includePinData": false,
  "secretPolicy": "redact",
  "includeWorkflowIds": [],
  "excludeWorkflowIds": [],
  "maxMinutes": 45,
  "notionRequestIntervalSeconds": 1,
  "forceFullVerification": false,
  "externalErrorHandler": false,
  "notifyOnErrors": false,
  "notifyOnChanges": false,
  "emailTo": "",
  "emailFrom": "",
  "notionMaxFileBytes": 5242880
};
if(!['backup','setup'].includes(config.operation))throw Error('Choose operation backup or setup');
const input=$input.first().json||{};const selected=Array.isArray(input.workflowIds)?input.workflowIds:config.includeWorkflowIds;
if(selected.some(id=>typeof id!=='string'||!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/.test(id)))throw Error('Invalid verification workflow ID');
return[{json:{...config,includeWorkflowIds:selected,setupOnly:input.setupOnly===true||(config.operation==='setup'&&['test','manual'].includes($execution.mode)),forceFullVerification:input.forceFullVerification===true||config.forceFullVerification===true}}];

const error=$input.first().json;let c={...error};try{c=$('Configuration').first().json;}catch{}return[{json:{schema:'n8n-notion-catalog-run/v1',workflowId:$workflow.id,executionId:$execution.id,failed:true,fatal:(typeof error.error==='string'?error.error:error.error?.message)||error.message||'Catalog runtime failure; inspect the failed node',counts:{failed:1},notificationRequired:c.notifyOnErrors===true&&!c.externalErrorHandler,emailTo:c.emailTo||'',emailFrom:c.emailFrom||'',message:'Notion catalog runtime failure. Inspect '+(c.n8nOrigin||'')+'/workflow/'+$workflow.id+'/executions/'+$execution.id}}];

let r;try{r=$('Backup report').first().json;}catch{r=$('Build failure report').first().json;}const x=$input.first().json;const ok=!x.error&&Array.isArray(x.accepted)&&x.accepted.some(a=>String(a).toLowerCase()===String(r.emailTo).toLowerCase())&&!(x.rejected||[]).length;return [{json:{...r,failed:r.failed||!ok,notificationDelivered:ok,...(!ok?{notificationError:'SMTP did not confirm acceptance'}:{})}}];
const r=$input.first().json;if(r.failed)throw Error('n8n → Notion catalog incomplete. '+JSON.stringify({counts:r.counts,fatal:r.fatal,executionId:r.executionId}));return[{json:{...r,ok:true}}];
const item=$input.first();if(!item.binary?.catalogState)throw Error('Catalog state file is missing');return[item];

parameters.content:
# n8n Workflow Backup to Notion

Automatically back up and document your n8n workflows in Notion, with structured documentation, verified JSON exports, and change tracking.

### How it works
- Retrieves active, inactive, and archived workflows via the n8n API.
- Creates or updates dedicated Notion pages with generated documentation.
- Uploads and verifies complete JSON workflow backups.
- Preserves personal notes and previous backups on failure.
- Tracks changes, handles API limits, and reports errors.

### Setup
- Import the workflow into n8n.
- Connect your n8n API and Notion credentials.
- Set a shared parent page to create the catalog automatically, or select an existing data source.
- Set URLs, scope and optional property aliases in **Configuration**.
- Run a manual test, verify backups, and enable the schedule.

### Requirements
- n8n instance with API access.
- Notion database and integration with read/write permissions.
- Sufficient Notion file-upload allowance.
- SMTP credentials (optional).
- No AI services or community nodes required.

### Customization
- Adjust backup frequency and time zone.
- Include or exclude specific workflows.
- Customize documentation through workflow sticky notes.
- Configure API limits, file sizes, and email notifications.

### Additional Info
- One-way backup: n8n → Notion.
- Restore workflows by importing their JSON files.
- Credentials, database, and encryption keys require separate backups.
- Failed backups are reported without deleting previous copies.

## 01 · Start and inventory

Start manually or hourly. Include active, inactive and archived workflows, follow pagination and check for overlapping executions. Keep only essential inventory metadata in memory.

## 02 · Controlled API requests

Prepare the state and attachments, respect Notion limits and send one request at a time. Bounded retries and explicit waits keep service failures visible.

## 03 · Catalog, README and JSON attachment

Read one source at a time, update its stable page and attach the complete .json file directly. Verify the downloaded bytes before retiring the previous copy or legacy JSON subpage. Preserve personal notes. If a file exceeds the Notion account limit, report an error and retain the previous backup.

Built-in setup creates or reuses the catalog before backing up. Set operation to setup for a manual catalog-only run. Original sticky notes are also copied into the generated documentation.

## 04 · Report and notifications

Compare expected coverage with actual results. Partial failures remain failures. Optional notifications check SMTP acceptance; the instance error handler covers unhandled execution failures.

## 05 · Execution failures

Send technical failures to the final report without claiming a successful sync. Preserve personal content and existing copies when verification fails.
